title: Forest Card: three ways to lay it out
question: Same world: deep green, white, Geist. Each variant changes how the screen is organised. Pick one, or steer.

options.label: A · The Card
options.thesis: Free-to-spend on one deep-green card; everything else on white panels below; floating tab bar.
options.risk: Many rounded panels can start to feel like a stack of cards.

options.label: B · Green Band
options.lineage: banking apps with a coloured top
options.thesis: The whole top of the screen is green with the tabs in it; a white sheet slides up over it with the rest.
materials: white sheet with one rounded top
options.viewport: Green band: Finances, tabs, free-to-spend, pace line. White sheet: Needs you, Still to pay, groups as one list.
options.risk: More green on screen; the band must stay calm so the number stays the loudest thing.

options.label: C · Quiet List
options.lineage: iOS Settings and Health: grouped lists
options.thesis: Mostly light; green only on the number, the pace area and what you can tap. Groups read as tidy lists.
options.viewport: Big green number on light ground, the pace area full width under it, then grouped lists; standard bottom tab bar.
options.risk: Closest to stock iOS; the satisfaction has to come from motion and type, not colour.
